summary: RE-TEST of Feb-2026 NivXRay enhancement bundle after iteration-11 fixes. All previously-failing scenarios now pass: (1) all 6 btn-chain-rerun-from-{idx} buttons render immediately after AUTO INVESTIGATE (no second RUN CHAIN click needed) — initialResult prop wiring works, (2) chain-break-{idx} ribbon renders with kind=LOW_CONFIDENCE when a stage genuinely gets sub-40 confidence (verified with '((()))' payload → stage 1 conf=32/100 → LOW_CONFIDENCE ribbon with data-break-kind attribute, AlertTriangle icon, colored border), (3) InputToolbar CSS shorthand-conflict React warning is GONE from console (0 occurrences across 4 edit-lock toggles). RE-RUN FROM STAGE 2 shows spinner and completes cleanly. EDIT+RE-RUN on stage 3 with c2-tracker.example works and drill output contains the new URL. All regression flows still pass. Iteration-11 gating bug is fully resolved.
critical_code_review_comments: ChainStageEditor.jsx line 74-85: initialResult prop wiring is clean and idempotent. Good fix.

classifyStageBreak's widened LOW_CONFIDENCE rule (conf<40 && inputLen>0) correctly fires for passthrough stages. Verified: '((()))' payload → magic engine, conf=32, chain=[], now flagged as LOW_CONFIDENCE. Previously would have been skipped.

Minor note (from previous iteration, still stands): the review's suggested garbage payloads ('zzzzzzzz', random symbols) do NOT reliably reach sub-40 confidence — the magic engine assigns conf=45 to these. Only very short pathological payloads like '((()))' currently trip the LOW_CONFIDENCE threshold. Not a blocker but if you want more consistent regression coverage, either (a) lower the LOW_CONFIDENCE threshold to <50, or (b) pin the regression test to a payload known to produce conf<40.

success_rate.frontend: 8/8 primary assertions PASS (100%). Clipboard read test inconclusive due to headless-browser clipboard permissions, not an app defect.
